text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hey, pup. I want some tea. Make it hot.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Also, turn up the heat. It's freezing in 
here.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm using this couch. What are you 
standing around for? Clear it off.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Also, bring me some painkillers. Hurry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I desperately met every single demand. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, well done. Alright, go to your 
kennel.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Back to the dorm, to the dorm. I'm gonna 
take a nap. Don't bother me, alright?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...I guess I really went overboard reading 
through all those overseas race articles.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli fell asleep almost 
immediately. She seems to be feeling quite 
sick.
